Hindu law , as a historical term, refers to the code of laws applied to Hindus , Buddhists , Jains and Sikhs in British India . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] [ 3 ] Hindu law, in modern scholarship, also refers to the legal theory, jurisprudence and philosophical reflections on the nature of law discovered in ancient and medieval era Indian texts. [ 4 ] It is one of the oldest known jurisprudence theories in the world, beginning three thousand years ago, and is based on the Hindu texts. [ 4 ] [ 5 ] [ 6 ]
